name: dasa_closed

phase_0.boundary_condition: the molecular orbital envelope of the cyclized Stenhouse adduct

VINIT.justification: the uncyclized state before the photo-thermal trigger initiates the reaction

TANCH.justification: the final stable geometric configuration that contains the molecular system

AFWD.justification: the forward transformation from an open-chain to a cyclic structure

AREV.justification: the reverse transformation returning the cyclic form to the open-chain state

CLINK.justification: the sequential bonding of the amine donor and the acidic acceptor to the carbon chain

IMSCRIB.justification: the specific chemical formula and connectivity that remains constant throughout isomerization

FSPLIT.justification: the branching of the planar precursor into distinct R and S chiral configurations

FFUSE.justification: the reconstitution of the bulk chemical identity from the individual enantiomeric paths

EVALT.justification: the successful attainment of the cyclized isomer

EVALF.justification: the failure to cyclize or the persistence of the elongated chromophore

ENGAGR.justification: a dynamic equilibrium where open and closed forms coexist under constant illumination

IFIX.justification: the permanent fixation of the molecular geometry into a solid-state lattice

phase_3.void_description: pre-synthetic reagents before the formation of the Stenhouse adduct
phase_3.true_description: the cyclized colorless isomer with established stereocenters
phase_3.false_description: the elongated colored isomer with conjugated pi-system
phase_3.both_description: the equilibrium mixture of isomers during active photo-switching

steps.domain_action: the open-chain donor-acceptor triene exists in a high-energy state
the molecule recognizes its specific donor and acceptor substituents
the system undergoes a 4π-electrocyclization toward the closed form
the cyclization event forces the creation of new stereocenters
the T-branch follows the successful formation of the cyclopentenone ring
the new carbon-carbon bond links the terminal ends of the triene
the specific chiral configuration is recorded in the molecular geometry
the stereochemical paths converge into the stable closed-form population
the closed colorless form reaches its terminal stable boundary

phase_5.ipc_mechanism: electronic push-pull effects between donor and acceptor groups
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the configuration of the chiral centers at the ring junction
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the reaction kinetics and quantum yield of the cyclization
phase_5.alfs_store: the CLINK L8 Organism catalog entry for dasa_closed

phase_6.cycle_cost: photon absorption or thermal energy transfer
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the decrease in molecular entropy is compensated by the release of heat to the surroundings
